sloka: यदा हि रामः पृथिवीमवाप्स्यति ।प्रभूतरत्नाकरशैलपत्तनाम् ।तदा गमिष्यस्यशुभं पराभवं ।सहैव दीना भरतेन भामिनि ॥२-८-३८॥
transliteration: yadā hi rāmaḥ pṛthivīmavāpsyati ।prabhūtaratnākaraśailapattanām ।tadā gamiṣyasyaśubhaṁ parābhavaṁ ।sahaiva dīnā bharatena bhāmini ॥2-8-38॥

translations.english: O lovely lady when Rama becomes the lord of this earth with its oceans, mountains and cities, then along with Bharata you will become miserable and fall into disgrace.
